cohort: The study included 185 pregnant women with a gestational age greater than or equal to 25 weeks visiting Kamali Hospital, Karaj, Iran.
finding: There was no significant difference in the frequency of preterm labor and the duration of pregnancy among the groups, although the rate of preterm delivery was lower in the oral probiotic group.
gest_age: Participants had a gestational age greater than or equal to 25 weeks at the time of intervention.
